name: Lumi

additionalSources.name: Official Monster Manual III errata, July 2006

evidence: The official errata adds Extraplanar to the two published Lumi stat blocks. The base player traits remain on p. 99. Disrupt undead is a ranged touch attack with no save in the revised SRD, despite the printed parenthetical DC.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

name: Maug

additionalSources.name: Shadowdale: The Scouring of the Land (2007), p. 37, 3.5 Maug class example

evidence: The printed player paragraph gives class level +5 as ECL, corresponding to two retained construct HD and LA +3. The official 3.5 booklet identifies damage reduction and construct construction costs as its Fiend Folio changes. Shadowdale p. 37 confirms the 3.5 Construct traits, class scaling, and printed DC 18.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

name: Nerra
pages: 127–130, Nerra Characters on pp. 128–129 and Varoot stat block on p. 130
evidence: The published ECL example is Varoot Rogue 1 at ECL 4, so it replaces its one outsider HD with the first class level. The print-era weapon sidebar calls shard weapons +2 wounding weapons. This build uses the revised core wounding property and names disguise self as the revised equivalent of change self.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.
